name: Skill — Panel Ask
description: Broadcast a single intent across multiple AI voices in parallel and synthesize the replies with cross-family discipline. Wraps the parallel-fleet-broadcast pattern as a first-class OpenClaw tool so any agent can summon the External Council programmatically.

defaultMode.label: Default Mode
defaultMode.help: raw collects per-voice replies. synthesize folds them via Opus 4.7 with cross-family discipline.

defaultVoices.label: Default Voices
defaultVoices.help: Voice IDs invoked when the caller does not specify a subset. Empty array = all healthy voices in the registry.

perVoiceTimeoutMs.label: Per-voice Timeout (ms)
perVoiceTimeoutMs.help: Hard ceiling for a single voice's reply. Slow voices that exceed this do not block faster ones; the panel still completes with a partial set.

outputDir.label: Output Directory
outputDir.help: Where to write per-voice reply artifacts. Each voice gets a file named <Label>-<Voice>-<Date>.md.

scriptPath.label: Dispatch Script
scriptPath.help: Absolute path to the apex-panel-ask.mjs dispatch script. Defaults to the bundled extensions/memory-graph/scripts/apex-panel-ask.mjs.
